title: Expired shares retain read access
expected: Shares authorize reads only before expires_at and while not revoked.
observed: A recipient received HTTP 200 and the full synthetic document after expiry.
reproduction: Create a fresh app; Alice shares a to Bob with future expiry.
Verify Bob can read; set stored expiry to past timestamp.
GET a as Bob still returns document.
preconditions: Existing owner or valid share recipient; authorized fixture transition as described.
uncertainty: Production deployment and impact outside this synthetic service were not assessed.
impact: Former recipients retain document access beyond the authorized period.
remediation: Applied current-tenant prerequisite and strict future-expiry predicate in can_read; all ten tests pass.
